rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a jumble of disparate things, especially when the mixture feels untidy or incongruous.

example.english: Their drawer is stuffed with motley things, and even finding a pen is hard.
example.traditional: 佢個抽屜入面塞滿雜七雜八嘅嘢，搵支筆都難。
example.jyutping: keoi5 go3 cau1 tai3 jap6 min6 sak1 mun5 zaap6 cat1 zaap6 baat3 ge3 je5 wan2 zi1 bat1 dou1 naan4

rows.note: Use this when the variation is specifically in colour rather than in the types of things mixed together.

example.english: The temple fair entrance is hung with motley lanterns, which look beautiful at night.
example.traditional: 廟會門口掛滿五顏六色嘅燈籠，夜晚好靚。
example.jyutping: miu6 wui2 mun4 hau2 gwaa3 mun5 ng5 ngaan4 luk6 sik1 ge3 dang1 lung4 je6 maan5 hou2 leng3
